text: {"assertions":["On 2026-03-03, an off-by-one cent error was discovered in billing/invoice_totals.py that affected clients still pinned to the v1 SDK.","The root cause was the config loader reading the wrong environment file instead of the correct one.","The fix made environment selection explicit and failed closed on ambiguity, implemented in PR #6444 on branch fix/off-by-one-cent-1.","The issue can be reproduced by totaling an invoice with three prorated lines.","The problem was indicated by a one cent gap appearing in the reconciliation report.","The relevant test file is tests/billing/test_invoice_totals.py which is part of a Python stack.","After the fix, the flaky test failure rate improved from 88 failures per 100 runs to zero."]}
